patterns.note: Product features are illustrated with large, detailed mockups, often featuring hands interacting with the interface, integrated directly into the content flow.
The primary heading style uses a large, bold sans-serif font with a single word often italicized for emphasis, creating a distinctive visual rhythm.
The site employs a minimalist, high-contrast color palette primarily using black text on a light, off-white background, with subtle variations in background tone to delineate sections.

The hero section features a large, illustrative product graphic that scrolls upwards at a slightly slower rate than the main page content, creating a subtle parallax effect as it reveals subsequent sections.
Content sections are clearly defined by full-width background color shifts between white and a subtle off-white, providing visual separation without harsh lines.

technique_notes: Product features are visually explained through large, realistic mockups of the software interface, frequently incorporating human hands interacting with the screen to convey usability and a tangible experience. These mockups are often full-bleed within their content areas.

The hero section utilizes a scroll-driven animation where a large, illustrative graphic containing the product interface moves upwards at a slightly different speed than the page's main scroll, giving the impression that content is either scrolling over or revealing from behind it. The main navigation bar becomes sticky after initial scroll.
The site maintains a consistent centered content column within full-width sections, using generous vertical padding to create an airy feel and clear visual hierarchy between distinct content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with a distinct italicized word in the hero, paired with a clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on buttons, input fields, and card elements).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, highly detailed product mockups, often featuring hands interacting with the interface, effectively grounds the abstract concept of a CRM in a tangible, user-friendly experience. This visual storytelling is central to its design.
